topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Why does everything have to change? Just when we figured out how to navigate this mess together, you're up and leaving. I can't wrap my head around how you could just decide this. I don't want to lose the one person who gets it. How are we supposed to keep this going from a thousand miles away? What's the point? All the times we said we'd be there, no matter what, and now you're making it impossible. I need you here, not someplace else, fading away into emails and the rare call. This isn't how it's supposed to end.
